tasks.goal: Three INDEPENDENT command-line utilities, each in its OWN subdirectory of the workspace, sharing no code and no files: (1) hexhead/ — Node CLI printing the first 16 bytes of a file (argv[2]) as space-separated lowercase hex, exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file; (2) dupwords/ — Node CLI printing each word that appears more than once in a text file (argv[2]), one per line, exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file; (3) padleft/ — Node CLI printing each line of a file (argv[2]) left-padded with spaces to 20 characters, exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file. EACH subdirectory ships its own package.json, fixtures, and README with a 'Verified invocations' section documenting real observed behaviour. The plan MUST include, for each tool, a SEPARATE FINAL VERIFICATION STEP distinct from its build step: re-run every invocation documented in that tool's README exactly as written and confirm stdout/stderr/exit codes match what the README claims.

Three INDEPENDENT command-line utilities, each in its OWN subdirectory of the workspace, sharing no code and no files: (1) firstn/ — Node CLI printing the first N lines of a file: path as argv[2], N as argv[3] (default 5), exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file or non-positive N; (2) vowelcount/ — Node CLI printing the number of vowels in a file (argv[2]), exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file; (3) joinlines/ — Node CLI printing a file (argv[2]) with all lines joined by a single space, exit 1 with clear stderr on missing/unreadable file. EACH subdirectory ships its own package.json, fixtures, and README with a 'Verified invocations' section documenting real observed behaviour. The plan MUST include, for each tool, a SEPARATE FINAL VERIFICATION STEP distinct from its build step: re-run every invocation documented in that tool's README exactly as written and confirm stdout/stderr/exit codes match what the README claims.
